svg.title: Thai Max Nguyen · the trust line
svg.desc: I build the wallet inside the chat app Vietnam lives on. Thai Max Nguyen, Senior Product Manager at Zalopay, moved from merchant payments to onboarding, identity (VNeID sign-up), the 12-person login and identity team he led (login, anti-fraud) and Buy Now Pay Later credit. Next stop: Singapore.
svg.text: THAI MAX NGUYEN · SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, ZALOPAY

g.text: the chat app Vietnam lives on.

svg.text: Zalopay lives inside Zalo. Three years on its payments, identity and credit.
The rule is not the obstacle. It is the rail.
Next station: Singapore. Please mind the platform gap.
